"Can the developers or anyone else read my backup files?
No, it is impossible for anyone but you and the receiving device to read your backup files. Before uploading the backup, all files are encrypted with a random 256-bit key using AES/CTR, and hashed with SHA-384. The key and hash is shown in the QR code and never sent to the server, making it impossible for any third party to access or tamper with your data."

"KIK-X2 is a brand-new app, created from scratch with the latest technology. It's inspired by the Kik X project that Kik was working on in 2019, but ultimately cancelled.
Kik is not just an app for many, it's a great app that people love with a lot of untapped potential, which has been held back by the current leadership choosing to maintain the status quo rather than innovate.
This app seeks to revive the idea Kik had, and make it great. Its goal is to deliver what MediaLab never did: fast, efficient, and revolutionary messaging.
KIK-X2 is a movement comprised of people who want and deserve better. I hope you enjoy it like I enjoyed making it."
